title: Why Are We Always Searching For Something More? (1979-07-10)
description:
Tired of spiritual concepts that remain just theories? Discover how to physically experience your inner awakening and free yourself from the ego.

This public program explores the subtle system, explaining how the ego creates the illusion of karma and separates us from the divine. Shri Mataji clarifies that true spiritual awakening cannot be paid for, culminating in a practical guided meditation to physically feel your Kundalini energy.

Key Topics:
• 🧠 Understanding the ego and superego - how mental and emotional extremes form barriers in our awareness that separate us from the whole
• 🌟 The mechanics of evolution - how the three subtle energy channels govern our existence, creativity, and ultimate spiritual ascent
• 💭 The illusion of karma - why our ego accumulates karma and how entering thoughtless awareness naturally dissolves past conditioning
• 🕊️ Why true spiritual awakening must be spontaneous, absolutely free, and cannot be achieved through mental effort or financial payment
• ⚡ Guided self-realization experience - feel the spontaneous awakening of your Kundalini and cool vibrations on your central nervous system

“You are not come to a shop, to demand something, but to get a blessing. You are not paying for it and you cannot pay for it. It is an insult to even to think that you can pay for God.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How does the ego block spiritual growth and awakening?
• What are the physical signs of kundalini energy rising?
• How to overcome karma and achieve spiritual freedom?

Have you felt the cool breeze of your Kundalini awakening on your hands? Share your first experience of true thoughtless awareness below!
